items.title: Show terminal outcome categories in dashboard and session brief
items.context: Dashboard currently renders doneStories/totalStories DONE percent, which users read as technical completion. Add derived counts/labels for DONE-success, DONE-blocked, DONE-audit-only, keeping the original lifecycle count but naming it as lifecycle progress. Source should be summary outcome metadata when present and conservative defaults for legacy stories.
items.userSees: session_brief and dashboard show lifecycle progress separately from outcome breakdown, for example: Lifecycle DONE 23/26; outcomes success=20 blocked=2 audit-only=1, so blocked spike DONE no longer looks like technical success.

happy.desc: Dashboard renders lifecycle DONE progress separately from DONE-success, DONE-blocked, and DONE-audit-only outcome counts.

edge.desc: Legacy DONE stories without summary outcomeKind still render in a backward-compatible success/default bucket without crashing dashboard/session output.

adversarial.desc: A DONE-blocked story contributes to lifecycle DONE but not to success count, preventing the percentage from implying technical success.

items.title: Let summary_set record explicit completion outcome kind
items.context: Story summary currently has acceptanceVerdict accepted/partial/rejected, which cannot distinguish a successful delivery from a blocked spike that completed by classifying failure. Add a small enum such as success/blocked/audit_only to summary schema/CLI/rendering, with backward-compatible defaulting.
items.userSees: summary_set accepts an explicit outcomeKind and summary output shows both acceptance verdict and completion outcome, e.g. verdict=partial with outcome=blocked tells users the story closed by classifying a blocker, not by shipping success.

happy.desc: summary_set accepts outcomeKind=success|blocked|audit_only and summary_get returns the stored value.

edge.desc: Existing summary_set calls without outcomeKind remain valid and default to success-compatible rendering for legacy stories.

adversarial.desc: Invalid outcomeKind values fail schema validation with a clear enum error and do not write summary metadata.

items.title: Support verdict-style verification evidence for blocked or audit stories
items.context: Spike stories may pass by proving and classifying a failure, but current evidence result pass/fail/waiver wording is awkward. Add an explicit evidence verdict field that can represent success, blocked-classified, audit-only, or waived while preserving existing gate behavior and stale evidence checks.
items.userSees: Verification coverage output can say verdict=blocked-classified or verdict=audit-only for explicit spike/audit evidence, so the user sees that a failure was classified rather than hidden behind pass/fail wording.

happy.desc: verification_evidence_add accepts verdict=blocked_classified and renderVerificationCoverage displays the verdict next to the evidence.

edge.desc: Evidence without a verdict keeps existing pass/fail/waiver behavior and stale freshness checks unchanged.

adversarial.desc: A failed evidence result with verdict=blocked_classified does not silently count as success unless the evidence kind/result rules still satisfy the existing gate semantics.

verificationEvidence.note: packages/main/src/tasks/outcome-semantics-smoke.ts: verification_evidence_add schema accepts verdict=blocked_classified and coverage renders it.
packages/main/src/tasks/deferred-gate-evidence-smoke.ts: existing waiver/freshness semantics still pass with evidence lacking verdict.

items.title: Clarify worktree authority wording when main metadata lags
items.context: session_brief can say worktree phase REVIEW; main metadata still says INIT_CHECK. Koala handles it, but the wording feels like data corruption. Rephrase as normal worktree authority/mirror lag and point to cd path/action.
items.userSees: When an active worktree is ahead of main metadata, session_brief says the worktree is authoritative and main metadata is a lagging mirror, then gives the exact cd command instead of implying corruption.

happy.desc: session_brief renders worktree-authoritative wording when worktree phase differs from main metadata phase.

edge.desc: When there is no phase mismatch, session_brief keeps the concise existing authority wording.

adversarial.desc: The phrase main metadata still says does not appear in the new mismatch guidance.

verificationEvidence.note: packages/main/src/handlers/session.ts: no-mismatch branch still uses concise authority phase wording.
packages/main/src/tasks/outcome-semantics-smoke.ts: smoke rejects old phrase main metadata still says.

items.title: Add focused smoke coverage for outcome semantics UX
items.context: Cover dashboard/session terminal outcome rendering, summary_set outcomeKind parsing/defaults, verdict evidence coverage rendering, and phase authority wording. Avoid changing aux_doc_list scope in this story.
items.userSees: Running the focused outcome-semantics smoke prints a clear pass line proving dashboard outcome breakdown, summary outcomeKind, verdict evidence rendering, and worktree authority wording are all guarded against regression.

happy.desc: A focused smoke command prints outcome semantics smoke passed after covering dashboard/session/summary/evidence behaviors.

edge.desc: The smoke does not require aux_doc_list scope expansion or unrelated documentation indexing changes.

adversarial.desc: The smoke fails if outcome wording regresses back to a single ambiguous DONE percentage or old alarming main metadata wording.
